name: How long does a typical bathtub-to-shower conversion take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathtub-to-shower conversion take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathtub-to-shower conversion varies based on the complexity of the project. A basic conversion using a pre-fabricated shower pan and wall system might be completed in as little as 3-5 days. More elaborate custom projects involving tiling, plumbing relocation, or structural modifications could take 1-2 weeks or longer. Factors like material availability, drying times for grout and sealants, and the extent of demolition required all influence the timeline. Opus Builders will provide a detailed project schedule during the initial consultation.
